a.s: Tap the sea to set a course; the ship sails there on its own.
a.k: sailing как ходить под парусом sail move wind парус ход плыть ветер движение tap the sea to set a course; the ship sails there on its own. tap any point of the sea: the ship turns and sails there. the chart shows the whole sea: open it to plan a long voyage.

a.s: A port repairs the ship, trades goods and hires crew.
a.k: ports порты port harbour dock порт гавань причал торговля a port repairs the ship, trades goods and hires crew. sail close to a port, tap it and press «open port». inside: the market, the shipyard, the tavern and the flag office. the army is hired in port: the «army» tab, «hire army».

a.s: Drag the wheel the way to sail; «+» and «−» set the sail; the arc shows how much canvas is set; on a keyboard, W/A/S/D.
a.k: the wheel and the sails штурвал и паруса wheel helm sails speed keys штурвал паруса скорость клавиши управление drag the wheel the way to sail; «+» and «−» set the sail; the arc shows how much canvas is set; on a keyboard, w/a/s/d. the wheel, bottom left. press it and pull towards where you want to go: the ship turns that way. the farther from the middle, the more sail. hold the very middle for half a second to furl everything; a quick double tap is a dash (once in 14 s). «+» and «−» beside the wheel add or take in one step of sail. there are four steps: a quarter, a half, three quarters and full; the pips between the buttons show which is set. the gold arc round the wheel is the canvas actually drawing; a fainter part is what you ordered but the torn sails cannot give. under it, the speed in knots. when the sails fall below a fifth the arc turns red-brown. on a keyboard: w or ↑ adds sail, s or ↓ takes it in, a/d or ←/→ turn the rudder, a lone shift is the dash, space fires, q and e fire a broadside, r repairs, m opens the chart. every key can be changed: settings → «more settings» → «controls».

a.s: Tap the open sea and the helmsman takes her there; the pill on top shows the way left and «stop». Any turn of the wheel takes the helm back.
a.k: a course by tap курс по тапу autosail course tap helmsman автоплавание курс рулевой тап метка tap the open sea and the helmsman takes her there; the pill on top shows the way left and «stop». any turn of the wheel takes the helm back. tap the open water: a dashed course runs from the ship to the mark, and the pill «to the mark · 320 m» comes up on top. the helmsman keeps the sail you had (three quarters if you were nearly stopped) and stops close by the mark. far away is easier on the chart. with a finger, a tap on the sea sets off at once; with a mouse, a click sets the mark, then press «sail there». «remove the mark» clears it. a long press on the minimap does the same. to take the helm back, turn the wheel (or a/d) or press «stop» on the pill. «+» and «−» only change the helmsman's sail; the course stays. a fight pauses the course: if you set it yourself, it carries on 5 s after the fight is over.

a.t: The chart, «Where am I» and the minimap
a.s: The minimap (top right) opens the chart. Its chips switch the layers; «Where am I» brings your ship back into view.
a.k: the chart, «where am i» and the minimap карта, «где я» и мини-карта chart map minimap layers where карта мини-карта слои где я метка the minimap (top right) opens the chart. its chips switch the layers; «where am i» brings your ship back into view. the chart of the known sea. the chips on top are layers: «ports», «goals», «lairs», «treasure», «all», «shipyards». tap one to show or hide it; the choice is remembered. «all» also draws the currents. «where am i» centres the chart on your ship, zooms in and makes your mark pulse for a moment. lost after scrolling far? one tap. the minimap shows 4.5 km around the ship. a tap opens the big chart; a long press sets a mark and sends the helmsman to it. the arrow on its rim is the wind.

a.s: With the wind behind, up to +45 % speed; into the wind, slower, and dead into it you barely move. Currents carry the ship on their own.
a.k: wind and currents ветер и течения wind current speed ветер течение скорость фордевинд бейдевинд with the wind behind, up to +45 % speed; into the wind, slower, and dead into it you barely move. currents carry the ship on their own. the arrow on the minimap's rim is the wind. green: it helps your course. red: it is against you. blue: it blows across your beam. the wind behind adds up to +45 % to the speed, a head wind takes up to a fifth off. every rig has a "dead" angle into the wind: square sails 65°, fore-and-aft 42°, mixed 52°. turn off the wind a little and the knots come back. currents are the pale lines with chevrons on the chart (layer «all»). they run at 3–4.6 m/s and carry the ship whether her sails are up or not: ride them for free speed, and steer across them carefully.

a.s: In a storm, never sail with full canvas: it tears. Three quarters is safe. With the sails gone and no sailcloth, raise the jury sail.
a.k: storms and the jury sail шторм и аварийный парус storm weather sails jury шторм погода паруса аварийный парус рифы in a storm, never sail with full canvas: it tears. three quarters is safe. with the sails gone and no sailcloth, raise the jury sail. the toast «storm! reef the sails or lose them.» means the storm is on you. a storm also shortens the lookouts' sight; a black storm takes 15 off the crew's morale. take one step off with «−»: under full sail the storm tears your canvas every moment, at three quarters it does not. the helmsman on a course reefs to three quarters by himself. weather it out and you get experience and flotsam nearby. sails below a fifth and no sailcloth in the hold? press «jury sail». the crew rig it for free, up to a quarter of the canvas, in a minute. it pauses under fire and when a fire is aboard. the sails bar in the corner grows as the crew work. even torn sails keep at least 40 % of the way. stuck dead in the water? «scuttle» sinks her and brings you back to port.

a.s: Trade goods over half the hold (three quarters on a trader's hull) — overload, −20 % speed. Over the brim — −35 %. Ship's stores do not count.
a.k: the hold and overload трюм и перегруз hold cargo overload trade трюм груз перегруз товары скорость trade goods over half the hold (three quarters on a trader's hull) — overload, −20 % speed. over the brim — −35 %. ship's stores do not count. the fourth bar under the portrait is the hold. the tick on it is the overload line: half the hold, or three quarters on trade and hauler hulls. the bar turns amber as you come near. past the line the bar reads «overload» and the ship loses 20 % of her speed. only trade goods count; provisions, sailcloth and planks never do. over 100 % of the hold, everything counted, it is −35 %. the effect «overloaded» shows by the portrait with its penalty. tap it for the card: what fills the hold and how much speed it costs. the cure is simple: sell in port («sell» on the market) or put goods in the warehouse. an overloaded hold also blocks the neutral flag and the passage between hubs.

a.s: Provisions feed the crew, sailcloth mends the sails, planks mend the hull. They are light, every harbour sells them, and they cannot be sold.
a.k: ship's stores судовые припасы provisions food sailcloth planks stores провизия еда парусина доски припасы provisions feed the crew, sailcloth mends the sails, planks mend the hull. they are light, every harbour sells them, and they cannot be sold. provisions, sailcloth and «planks & pitch» stand first on every market, marked as ship's stores. every harbour has them without limit. they are light: 0.05 m³ a unit (planks 0.075). instead of «sell» they show a greyed «store»: stores are kept for the voyage, not for trade. in return they never count towards overload, the neutral flag's free hold or the passage's limit. cast off short of something, and a window lists what is missing for a normal voyage: food, repairs, shot, hands — with prices. buy item by item, «buy all», or «sail as she is». the provisions row shows how much is aboard. at sea the crew eat about half a unit a minute per 40 hands. when the last biscuit is gone, morale slides towards 25. one plank mends 40 points of hull, one bolt of sailcloth 20 points of sails.

a.s: At sea, out of a fight: «Repair» (R) — the crew mend with planks and sailcloth. In port the yard mends everything for silver.
a.k: repairs ремонт repair hull sails shipyard ремонт корпус паруса верфь доски at sea, out of a fight: «repair» (r) — the crew mend with planks and sailcloth. in port the yard mends everything for silver. the bars under the portrait: red is the hull, blue the crew, white the sails. when the hull or the sails drop, it is time to mend. «repair» appears at the bottom when nothing is shooting at you (or press r). the crew mend as fast as their numbers allow, using planks for the hull and sailcloth for the sails; «stop repair» stops. under fire the work goes ten times slower. in port, «shipyard» → «repair» mends the hull, sails, rudder, guns and mast at once. small ships pay less. short of silver? the yard mends what you can pay for. a whole ship shows «sound» on the button.

a.s: Morale tends to 70. Hunger, curses and black storms lower it, rum raises it. High spirits load faster and board harder; low ones slow everything.
a.k: the crew and morale команда и боевой дух crew morale mutiny rum команда боевой дух бунт ром матросы morale tends to 70. hunger, curses and black storms lower it, rum raises it. high spirits load faster and board harder; low ones slow everything. the crew window («the company») shows the hands aboard, your army's stacks and «morale». it drifts towards 70: +8 with rum in the hold, down to 25 with no food, lower still with cursed relics and on long voyages. 80 and up — «inspired»: reload −10 %, boarding +10 %. below 50 the guns reload slower and repairs go worse; below 30 the icon «low morale» appears; below 15 the crew refuse to board. low morale and low loyalty together lead to mutiny. hands are hired in the «tavern». keep the crew above the ship's minimum: fewer hands mean slower repairs and slower guns. in panic (morale 15–29) some sailors desert when you dock.

a.s: In port you leave at once. At sea press «Exit» in the «⋯» tray: 30 s, and any order cancels it. A dropped connection leaves the ship at sea for 2 minutes.
a.k: leaving the game выход из игры exit logout quit выход выйти отключение in port you leave at once. at sea press «exit» in the «⋯» tray: 30 s, and any order cancels it. a dropped connection leaves the ship at sea for 2 minutes. open the «⋯» tray by the portrait and press «exit». in port that is all: you are out at once. at sea the banner «exit in 0:30» counts down. any order or a shot at you cancels it, and you cannot leave in the middle of a fight. «cancel» stops it by hand. simply closing the game is not safe: the ship stays at sea for 2 minutes with your last order still running, and anyone can attack her. leave in port, or through «exit»: then the screen «you have left» offers «return».

a.s: The icons by the portrait are everything working on you now, the bad ones first, with the time left as a ring. Tap one for its card.
a.k: buffs and debuffs бафы и дебафы effects buffs debuffs timer эффекты бафы дебафы таймер значки the icons by the portrait are everything working on you now, the bad ones first, with the time left as a ring. tap one for its card. red rims are troubles: «rudder damaged», «canvas torn», «fire aboard», «leaks», «overloaded», «low morale». green rims help: «high spirits», «under protection», «dash». the ring is the time left, the number in the corner the strength. a tap opens the effect's card: what it is, how long it lasts and what exactly it changes — speed, reload, damage. a phone shows six icons, a wide screen eight; the rest hide behind «+3». tap it for «effects on you», the whole list with timers.

a.s: Tap a ship: a ring of what you can do with her comes up. «Attack», «Board» within 100 m, «Talk»; ⓘ opens her card.
a.k: the ring of actions кольцо действий ring target tap details кольцо цель тап подробнее карточка tap a ship: a ring of what you can do with her comes up. «attack», «board» within 100 m, «talk»; ⓘ opens her card. tap a ship (on a desk, hover over her) and the ring opens round her; tap again on a choice. «attack» is always there; «board» appears within 100 m; «talk» for every ship but the creatures of the deep. a greyed choice is forbidden by your flag: tap it to see why. the small ⓘ «details» beside the ring opens her card. beasts, monsters, ghosts and bosses get a single big «attack» — they cannot be talked to or boarded from the sea. the card: her captain, class, ship level, flag and role, guns a side, top speed, hold, the distance — and the two numbers that matter: «against you» and how many of your broadsides it takes to sink her. the bars are her hull, sails and crew right now; a beast shows only its body. the card refreshes twice a second, so you can watch the fight on it, and closes by itself if she is gone. at the bottom of the card: «target» (pin her), «attack», «sail to», «inspect». the boarding odds show there too, once they have been reckoned.

a.s: «Attack» puts the helmsman on her: he keeps gun range and turns your broadside to her. «Close in» goes for boarding, «Stand off» back to the guns, «Hold off» gives the wheel back.
a.k: «attack», «close in», «stand off» «атаковать», «сближение», «на выстрел» attack pursuit broadside distance атаковать погоня залп дистанция сближение на выстрел «attack» puts the helmsman on her: he keeps gun range and turns your broadside to her. «close in» goes for boarding, «stand off» back to the guns, «hold off» gives the wheel back. in the ring tap «attack». the helmsman takes the wheel: he holds her at about 0.6 of your guns' reach (90–140 m) and lays your broadside to her; the gunners fire when she is in reach. no grapples are thrown on their own. while you hunt, the bar at the bottom changes: «close in» and «hold off». the helmsman breaks off by himself if she is lost, faster than you, sunk — or your hull is under a quarter. «close in» brings you alongside for boarding; within 100 m «board» comes up. the same button now reads «stand off»: it opens the distance again, out of grapple reach, back to the guns. beasts and monsters have no «close in». «hold off» ends the pursuit and gives you the wheel. turning the wheel yourself does the same.

a.s: Round shot breaks the hull, chain tears the sails (she cannot run), grape kills the crew (before boarding). Tap the shot button to change it.
a.k: round, chain and grape ядра, книппели, картечь ammo shot chain grape reload снаряды ядра книппели картечь перезарядка round shot breaks the hull, chain tears the sails (she cannot run), grape kills the crew (before boarding). tap the shot button to change it. the shot button beside «fire» shows what is loaded and how many are aboard. a tap takes the next kind; keys 1–5 pick round, chain, grape, fire and heavy shot. hold it for the wheel «shots» with every kind, the abilities and the talents. round shot: full damage to the hull, longest reach. chain: a quarter to the hull but 45 times more to the sails — a fast ship stops running. grape: little to the hull, the most crew killed, but only half the reach. «fire» fills up as the guns reload. changing the shot costs part of a reload, so choose before the volley. hold «fire» for 1.2 s for a charged broadside: let go near the end of the charge for a tighter, harder volley.

a.s: Every gun reaches 100 m farther than its base: a long nine fires round shot to 305 m. Chain reaches less, grape least.
a.k: ranges дальность range reach distance volleys дальность дистанция залпы пушки every gun reaches 100 m farther than its base: a long nine fires round shot to 305 m. chain reaches less, grape least. the target line on top shows her name, the distance and «≈ 4 volleys» — how many of your broadsides she will take — and, close enough, the boarding odds. reach = the gun's base × the ship's range × the shot's range + 100 m. a long 9-pounder: 305 m with round, about 248 with chain, 213 with grape. a 24-pound carronade: 200 m. mortars throw to 550 m. far shots still lose up to 30 % of their damage towards the edge of the reach. pirate ships open fire from 250 m but like to fight at 105–140 m.

a.s: Within 100 m (hull to hull) «Board» throws the grapples: 2–4 s, and the ships are hauled together. Then the battle on the hexes.
a.k: boarding абордаж boarding grapple odds risk абордаж кошки шанс риск within 100 m (hull to hull) «board» throws the grapples: 2–4 s, and the ships are hauled together. then the battle on the hexes. «board» appears in the ring when she is within 100 m, hull edge to hull edge, from any side — and only if your flag allows the attack. before you go, check the odds. the target line on top shows her hull and whether she is in reach; close by it adds «boarding 62%» — your chance to win on deck (her card ⓘ has the same «boarding odds»). grape first is the classic way to raise them. «grapples away: hauling her alongside». the haul takes 2–4 s, the lighter ship moves more and the other cannot sail off. if your odds are under 35 % or she is 2+ levels above you, the game asks first: «risk it» or «back off».

a.s: A turn-based fight on an 11×9 field, as in Heroes. Initiative sets the order; shots at up to 6 hexes do full damage; flank +15 %, rear +30 %; cover −25 %.
a.k: the boarding battle: the basics бой на гексах: основы hex battle initiative flank cover shooting гексы бой инициатива фланг укрытие стрелки a turn-based fight on an 11×9 field, as in heroes. initiative sets the order; shots at up to 6 hexes do full damage; flank +15 %, rear +30 %; cover −25 %. the deck becomes a field of 11×9 hexes: your stacks on one side, hers on the other. first, 20 s to place your stacks; then each stack has 20 s for its move, and you have a chess clock for the whole fight. the queue on top is the order of turns: higher initiative acts first, ties go to the dice. tap a foe to strike: the stack walks up and hits. tap a foe: the preview shows the damage, how many fall and her answer, and «attack» comes up at the bottom. from the side a blow does +15 %, from behind +30 % — walk round before you strike. shooters hit with full damage up to 6 hexes, beyond that «long shot: half». a mast, barrel, crate, gun or barricade by the target or on the line of fire gives «in cover: −25 %». a shooter with a foe next to it hits at half.

a.t: Morale, luck and the twenty rounds
a.s: Good morale may give a stack another turn, bad morale may freeze it; luck doubles a blow. After round 20 the side with more of its strength left wins.
a.k: morale, luck and the twenty rounds мораль, удача и двадцать раундов morale luck rounds card мораль удача раунды карточка атака защита good morale may give a stack another turn, bad morale may freeze it; luck doubles a blow. after round 20 the side with more of its strength left wins. the queue on top runs round after round. there are at most 20 rounds: then the deck goes to the side with the larger share of its starting strength left (in a siege, to the defenders). morale and luck come from your crew's morale and your captain. each point is a 4 % chance: good morale — an extra turn, bad — the stack freezes; luck — a double blow. attack over defence adds 5 % a point (up to +100 %), the other way takes 2.5 % (down to −50 %). long-press a stack (right click on a desk) for its card: men, attack, defence, damage, health, speed, initiative, shots and whether it strikes back, plus its special abilities and how far it threatens.

a.s: «Auto» lets the crew fight for you (one auto-battle scroll a battle); «Quick combat» is free against a clearly weaker ship. The book holds your orders.
a.k: auto-battle and the order book автобой и книга приказов auto autobattle quick book scroll автобой быстрый бой книга свиток приказы «auto» lets the crew fight for you (one auto-battle scroll a battle); «quick combat» is free against a clearly weaker ship. the book holds your orders. the round «auto» button on the left. while auto is on it reads «take the helm» — tap it to fight by hand again. its wheel: «auto to the end», «quick combat», cutting the grapples or falling back, a ransom, and «strike the colours». auto spends one scroll a battle (packs in the shop); quick combat against a ship one and a half times weaker costs nothing. the round book bottom right is the «order book»: your officer's words and your path's orders, each with its cost. a gold dot on it means something is ready.

a.s: A beaten pirate, patrol or hunter may ask for mercy. «Take all and sink her» — her purse and hold; «Take her crew and let her go» — 30 % of her crew and purse.
a.k: a pirate strikes her colours пират спускает флаг surrender struck sink spare mercy сдача флаг утопить отпустить пощада a beaten pirate, patrol or hunter may ask for mercy. «take all and sink her» — her purse and hold; «take her crew and let her go» — 30 % of her crew and purse. «the ship strikes her colours!» she gives up when her hull is under a quarter, her crew under 30 % or her morale broken, and you clearly out-gun her. only pirates, patrols and hunters do; monsters, bosses and named captains never. «take all and sink her»: her whole purse, her hold as far as yours takes it, 15 % of her survivors join you, and a wreck with timber and the rest floats up. «take her crew and let her go»: 30 % of her crew join, you take 30 % of her purse, and she sails away. hands join only while you have free hammocks. the card shows how far she is; she will not wait long (75 s). alongside your choice works at once; from farther the helmsman lays you alongside. «later» hides the card; firing on her refuses the surrender and the fight goes on.

a.s: Orcas, sharks, whales, narwhals and serpents bite the hull, never the crew. Only «Attack» — no grapples. Flense the carcass for oil, bone and teeth.
a.k: beasts and monsters звери и чудовища beasts monsters orca shark whale kraken звери чудовища касатка акула кит кракен orcas, sharks, whales, narwhals and serpents bite the hull, never the crew. only «attack» — no grapples. flense the carcass for oil, bone and teeth. a beast has no ring of choices: just «attack». it has no guns; it bites, and its bite grows with its level. each has its way: orcas and sharks go for the rudder, a narwhal's tusk opens a leak, a serpent coils round the hull, a sperm whale rams. they never kill crew. a wounded beast flees for a few seconds, then turns at bay. the kill gives experience, and the carcass floats for 5 minutes: heave to alongside to flense it. an orca gives whale oil, teeth and whalebone; a sperm whale oil, whalebone and sometimes ambergris. blood in the water draws sharks.

a.s: Neutral — quiet scouting with an 85 % free hold. City or guild — peace with the law, fights with pirates and monsters. Pirate — hardcore: rob anyone, and pay with skulls.
a.k: the three flags три флага flag colours neutral city guild pirate флаг нейтральный город гильдия пиратский neutral — quiet scouting with an 85 % free hold. city or guild — peace with the law, fights with pirates and monsters. pirate — hardcore: rob anyone, and pay with skulls. the flag is chosen in port: the «colours» chip in the port window's second row. each card says what the flag lets you do; the flying one is marked «flying». «neutral»: scouting and fishing. captains leave you alone and you cannot touch captains or peaceful ships; pirates attack only rarely. only while trade goods fill at most 15 % of the hold — load more and the city flag goes up by itself. only here «boarding: off» works against captains. «city or guild» — a new captain's flag: peace with the law. merchants, fishers and patrols leave you alone and you them; pirates, monsters and enemy captains attack. «pirate» — hardcore: rob merchants, fishers, patrols and captains. every victim is a skull. merchants flee, patrols hunt you; the sea's pirates count you as one of theirs until you fire on them. tap another flag and it goes up in a minute — but never sooner than 10 minutes after your last fight with a captain. leave port before that and the order is cancelled. in lawless waters no flag protects anyone.

a.t: Skulls and how to wash them
a.s: Under the pirate flag every peaceful victim is a skull. With one, the flag is locked; with two, lawful ports are shut. Wash them by time out of a fight or buy a pardon in a pirate haven.
a.k: skulls and how to wash them черепа и как отмыться skulls wanted infamy pardon черепа розыск дурная слава помилование under the pirate flag every peaceful victim is a skull. with one, the flag is locked; with two, lawful ports are shut. wash them by time out of a fight or buy a pardon in a pirate haven. the badge «☠1», «☠2» by the portrait is your skulls. one comes with the first blow on a merchant, fisher, lawful patrol or a captain who was not fair game. patrols chase a skulled ship, and lawful harbours near by send ships after her. while you carry a skull the flag cannot be changed: only the pirate one flies. with two skulls the ports of the crown, the league and the harpoon will not let you in. time washes them: out of a fight, about 10 minutes a skull. faster — a pardon, sold in the ports of the free harbors, the fog brokers and the red tide confederacy: «buy a pardon» on the flag card clears every skull at once. the price grows with your infamy and level. the same pardon is sold in «harbour» under «letters of pardon».

a.s: A switch on the flag card: no one boards you and you board no one — guns only. Against captains it works only under the neutral flag.
a.k: «boarding: off» «абордаж: выкл.» boarding noboard guns only neutral абордаж выкл нейтральный только пушки a switch on the flag card: no one boards you and you board no one — guns only. against captains it works only under the neutral flag. under the flag cards there is the switch «boarding: on / off». it is changed only in port and works at once. the note beside it says it: against captains it protects only under the neutral flag (under another flag, switched off, it reads «not in effect: your flag is not neutral»). against the sea's pirates it works under any flag. with boarding off, fights are settled by the guns. in lawless waters it does not work at all.

a.s: A licence to hunt your city's enemies without skulls: sold in the ports of the Crown, the League and the Harpoon, from level 10, for 7 days.
a.k: the privateer patent каперский патент patent privateer marque патент капер каперство a licence to hunt your city's enemies without skulls: sold in the ports of the crown, the league and the harpoon, from level 10, for 7 days. the «privateer patent» card is on the flag tab of a crown, league or harpoon port, while you fly that city's flag. you need level 10, no skulls, no oath to the code, and at least −10 standing with the city. «buy» — 7 days, renewable up to 14 days ahead. the price grows with your level: 3750 at levels 10–12, 6350 at 19–24, 13 900 at 37–42; marque rank takes up to a fifth off. the rules: 20 % of your prize silver goes to the city, pvp points ×0.75, enemy patrols hunt you within 9 km of their ports and their ports are closed to you. attack a ship that is neither an enemy nor an ally of your city — that is piracy: the patent burns and you get a skull.

a.t: PvP points and the monthly rewards
a.s: Sinking a captain is 10 points, boarding 14, a duel won 5. Each calendar month the top ten get silver, doubloons and titles; everyone with 50+ gets 3000 silver.
a.k: pvp points and the monthly rewards очки пвп и награды месяца pvp points season rewards rank пвп очки сезон награды рейтинг sinking a captain is 10 points, boarding 14, a duel won 5. each calendar month the top ten get silver, doubloons and titles; everyone with 50+ gets 3000 silver. the ranking is in the captain's window, under the «pvp» chip: your points, your place and the season's leaders. points scale with the victim's strength against yours (up to ×2.5); a captain under half your strength gives nothing. the same captain again within a day gives ×1, then ½, then ¼, then nothing. a guild-war kill ×1.5; a helper gets 40 %. the season is the calendar month (moscow time). first place: 30 000 silver, 500 doubloons and the title «terror of the seas»; second and third — 25 000 and 22 000 with their titles; places 4–10 from 20 000 down to 5000. you need at least 50 points.

a.s: Other captains' names are blue, a skulled captain's are red, and under the pirate flag the level is hidden behind «?».
a.k: name colours цвета имен names nameplate colour level имена цвет уровень черепа other captains' names are blue, a skulled captain's are red, and under the pirate flag the level is hidden behind «?». over every ship there is her name and level. other players' captains are written in bright blue — easy to tell from the sea's own ships. red name — the captain carries skulls: a pirate who has robbed someone. keep your distance or be ready. under the pirate flag the level badge shows «?»: you do not know how strong she is. open her card (ⓘ) before you start a fight.

a.s: Each port has its own prices, and they change every 8 hours. ▲ and ▼ show the trend; luxuries swing the most. Buy cheap here, sell dear there.
a.k: the market and prices рынок и цены market prices buy sell trend рынок цены купить продать тенденция each port has its own prices, and they change every 8 hours. ▲ and ▼ show the trend; luxuries swing the most. buy cheap here, sell dear there. «market» in the port window: a row a good — its picture, what you have aboard, the stock, the buy and sell prices, «buy» and «sell». below are the shot and the ship's stores. «new prices in …» counts down the price period: every 8 hours each port sets new prices. supplies move by about ±10 %, staples ±18 %, wares ±22 %, luxuries ±30 %, contraband and rarities ±35 %. ▲ — dearer than the last period, ▼ — cheaper. selling back where you bought within 16 hours pays at most 92 % of what you paid: real profit is carried, not flipped. lawful ports take a duty on sales: the crown 8 %, the league 5 %, the harpoon 3 %.

a.s: Tap a port on the chart for its card: what it sells and buys, cheap or dear. The «Market Sense» talent shows the exact prices you remember.
a.k: the port card and «market sense» карточка порта и «чутье рынка» port card prices chart market sense карточка порта цены карта чутье рынка tap a port on the chart for its card: what it sells and buys, cheap or dear. the «market sense» talent shows the exact prices you remember. the card of a port: its flag, how safe its waters are, «new prices in …», the passage from it — and at the bottom «sail here» or «open the port». further down: the market («food & stores», what it sells and buys), the yard, the tavern, your goods in its warehouse. for a port you have visited each good says «cheap», «usual» or «dear». with the trade talent «market sense» you see the exact prices you saw there and the trends of every port you know.

a.s: Every good says its room per unit, «m³/unit». Cheap goods are compact, valuable ones bulky: a unit of ambergris takes more than 80 bolts of sailcloth.
a.k: how much room goods take сколько места занимает товар volume hold room cargo объем трюм место груз кубометры every good says its room per unit, «m³/unit». cheap goods are compact, valuable ones bulky: a unit of ambergris takes more than 80 bolts of sailcloth. under the name of a good: «0.9 m³/unit» and so on. valuable goods take more: spices 0.9, medicine 1.1, pearls 1.8, abyssal ore 2.0, kraken ink 2.5, drowned silk 3.0, ambergris 4.2. cheap goods are compact: fish 0.25, salt 0.3, rum 0.55, tobacco 0.65, gunpowder 0.7. ship's stores are smaller still: 0.05 (planks 0.075). the hold's figure in the port window's head shows the room taken and the whole. count before you buy: half the hold in trade goods is overload (three quarters on a trader).

a.s: A warehouse of 120 m³ in any port: rent is paid once, on the first deposit. «Store all» and «Take all» for each good.
a.k: the warehouse склад warehouse storage holdings склад хранение владения a warehouse of 120 m³ in any port: rent is paid once, on the first deposit. «store all» and «take all» for each good. the warehouse is under «holdings» in the port window's second row. each good in the hold has «store all» and «take all». the first deposit pays the rent: 60 + 24 a level, never more than 300. the warehouse holds 120 m³. keep goods there to wait for a better price, to stay under the overload line, or to take the passage with a light hold.

a.s: «Quests» → «Contracts»: the port's contracts and bounties, the merchants' runs (buy here, deliver there by the deadline) and the Admiralty's board.
a.k: contracts and merchants' runs контракты и торговые поручения contracts runs delivery admiralty контракты поручения доставка адмиралтейство «quests» → «contracts»: the port's contracts and bounties, the merchants' runs (buy here, deliver there by the deadline) and the admiralty's board. in the port window open «quests» and the «contracts» chip: everything for the trader and the hunter on one page. «merchants' runs»: buy the lot here at the market price and bring it there by the deadline. the house pays its price and a bonus for speed — all of it while nearly half the time is left. deliver, and it offers the next leg; the fifth closes the chain with a present.

a.s: In bigger ports the «Exchange»: forwards, buy orders and the bank. In the Free Harbors the trophy auction: 10-minute lots, the house keeps a tenth.
a.k: the exchange and the auction биржа и аукцион exchange forwards orders bank auction биржа форварды заявки банк аукцион in bigger ports the «exchange»: forwards, buy orders and the bank. in the free harbors the trophy auction: 10-minute lots, the house keeps a tenth. «exchange» → «forwards»: lock today's price for a good delivered to another port by a deadline. the deposit comes back on full delivery. lawful exchanges take no plunder. «orders»: put silver down and let other captains bring you the goods; they wait in your warehouse here. an order lives 3 hours, the fee is 2 %. «bank»: silver in the bank survives a sinking (a tenth of what you carry goes down with the ship). withdrawal costs a small fee; a credit is offered too. the bank’s office is only in league ports and the big free ports. «auction» in the ports of the free harbors: rare pieces on the block for 10 minutes. a bid holds your silver; outbid, it comes back at once. a bid in the last minute adds a minute. the house keeps a tenth of a sale. each lot shows its piece, its rarity and level, the standing bid and what it is worth to the room. tap the piece for its card.

a.s: In the shop «Exchange» turns doubloons into silver at 1 : 200. One way only.
a.k: doubloons into silver дублоны в серебро doubloons silver exchange shop дублоны серебро обмен лавка in the shop «exchange» turns doubloons into silver at 1 : 200. one way only. open the shop (the «+» by your doubloons) and press «exchange» at the top. pick how many — 10, 50, 100, 500 or «all» — and press «exchange». each doubloon gives 200 silver. silver cannot be turned back into doubloons.

a.s: Any island without a port can be yours: the first one is free and immediate.
a.k: claiming an island как занять остров island claim base move остров занять база переезд свой город any island without a port can be yours: the first one is free and immediate. sail up to the shore of a wild island. when the ship is close enough, the action bar shows «claim» with the island's name: tap it. the claim card opens: its waters, its danger and the price. the first island costs nothing — press «claim free» and confirm. next to it — other free islands nearby with «sail» and the distance. a bigger island has more plots and outposts. the town hall stands from the first day. many captains may hold a base on the same island; port islands and pirate fortresses cannot be claimed. moving to another island: the first move is free, then 1 000 000 silver or 2 600 doubloons. the old buildings are pulled down; the treasury, the goods, the residents and your ships go with you.

a.s: Three guided steps with rewards: the Marine Barracks, hiring marines, the Shooting Range.
a.k: first steps on the island первые шаги на острове island tutorial steps barracks marines остров шаги казарма морпехи стрельбище губернатор three guided steps with rewards: the marine barracks, hiring marines, the shooting range. right after the claim a line appears at the top: «island 1/3: build the marine barracks». its button opens the right card on the island. the barracks need the crew quarters first — almost free: about 50 silver and a few logs. then the barracks: +300 silver and timber, iron and powder into the yard. step 2: «hire marines in any port». the ranks opened on your island are sold in every port, marked «your island». reward: +400 silver. step 3: build the shooting range — musketeers, tier 3. reward: +600 silver. a step counts only once the building stands, not while it is going up. short of money for the first buildings? once, the governor helps: the missing goods go to the yard and the silver to the treasury.

a.s: The Town Hall sets the island's level; seven dwellings train your army tier by tier.
a.k: the town and its dwellings город и жилища town hall dwellings keep market guild город ратуша жилища крепость рынок гильдия кубрик казарма the town hall sets the island's level; seven dwellings train your army tier by tier. open the island and tap «town» on the left. here is the whole homm-style town: the town hall, the walls, the dwellings and the market. the town hall pays silver into the treasury every dawn (60 to 400 a day) and raises the island's level. no building may stand higher than the hall. its name grows with the level: the council house, the town office, the governor's house… seven dwellings: crew quarters, marine barracks, shooting range, gun yard, veterans' den, admiralty, shrine of the drowned. each opens its tier for hire; from level 3 it trains the upgraded kind. the keep makes every dwelling grow more men: the citadel (level 3) by half, the castle (level 5) twice. the market trades resources, the guild of orders teaches orders. each card says what it needs first («first raise: …»). not sure what to build? the «next» card bottom right names the next useful step: tap it.

a.s: Levels 1 and 2 are almost free; the treasury pays first, then your purse.
a.k: building costs and the treasury цены построек и казна cost treasury silver build brigade цена казна серебро стройка бригада дешево levels 1 and 2 are almost free; the treasury pays first, then your purse. the price is on the card: silver, resources and time. level 1 costs 40–300 silver and a few logs, level 2 — 100–600. the whole first level is about 740 silver. from level 3 it grows steeply: the town hall 3 costs 5 350 silver and 8 hours, hall 4 — 48 000, hall 5 — 95 000. build the cheap levels everywhere first. the coin at the top is the island's treasury. building, the market and the barge are paid from it first, then from your purse — from anywhere, at sea or in port. builders: «brigades» at the bottom. one crew at first, a second from island level 3. each brigade builds one thing at a time.

a.t: «Bring in»: silver and goods to the island
a.s: Silver goes into the treasury from anywhere; goods are unloaded off the island; the barge brings timber, coal and iron.
a.k: «bring in»: silver and goods to the island «завезти»: серебро и товары на остров haul treasury deposit barge unload yard завезти казна положить барка выгрузить склад silver goes into the treasury from anywhere; goods are unloaded off the island; the barge brings timber, coal and iron. in the island window tap «bring in» on the left (or the treasury coin at the top). treasury: type an amount and press «put in the treasury», or «all the silver». it works from anywhere. «take out» works only off the island or in a port of its region. «order a barge»: it brings 30 timber, 20 coal and 5 iron per town hall level straight to the yard, for silver, from anywhere. the price is on the button. «unload to the yard»: lying off your island, timber, coal, tar, iron, provisions, powder, pearls and rum go from the hold to the yard, up to its limit. goods never go back out. while the ship lies off the island, building takes what it needs straight from the hold. the yard holds 150 + 50 per island level + 250 per warehouse level of each good.

a.s: A building can be razed for half its cost back; the plot is freed.
a.k: demolishing a building как снести здание raze demolish refund снести снос вернуть участок a building can be razed for half its cost back; the plot is freed. tap a standing building on the island: its card opens with «raze» at the bottom. the game asks once more. half of every standing level comes back: silver to the treasury, goods to the yard. work in progress is refunded in full. you cannot raze what others stand on («something rests on it») — nor the town hall or the grail. a razed dwelling loses its waiting men, and its tier is no longer hired.

a.s: Gear is tempered in the Forge (Town Hall 3+); artifacts are made in the Workshop and reforged on the Anvil (a Market is needed).
a.k: forge, workshop and anvil кузница, мастерская и наковальня forge temper gear artifact anvil workshop craft кузница закалка шмот снаряжение артефакт наковальня мастерская gear is tempered in the forge (town hall 3+); artifacts are made in the workshop and reforged on the anvil (a market is needed). the forge is a plot building, open from town hall 3. while the ship lies off the island it works as a shipyard for gear: tempering, reforging, mending. tempering is in the gear window: tap a piece, then «temper to +n». each step adds 3 % to the main line, up to 5 times («tempered +5»); it costs silver, iron and planks from the hold. «reforge a line» rolls one line anew. a port with a shipyard of rank 2+ does the same. the «workshop» in the island's town makes artifacts from land trophies (shell, bone, venom from the lairs) and silver: the mail-lined coat, the marksman's bandolier, the orca talisman, the medal of saint mercy. it needs a market of level 1 to 3 and the ship off the island. the «anvil» reforges an artifact: its primary skills or one forged line. the new work lies next to the old until you choose. each strike costs half the first price more, up to three times it.

a.s: Lumber camps, quarries and mines fill the yard by the hour; collect with «Collect».
a.k: producers and the yard промыслы и склад producers lumber mine yield collect yard промысел лесоповал каменоломня рудник собрать склад ресурсы lumber camps, quarries and mines fill the yard by the hour; collect with «collect». tap a free plot («+») and choose a producer. at level 1 per hour: lumber camp 8 timber, quarry 6 coal, tar kiln 4 tar, iron mine 3 iron, fishing crew 8 provisions. each level adds half again (×3 at level 5), then the island's land decides: on some islands a producer gives more, on some it cannot be built at all. the yard counters run along the top: what is stored and the limit. when producers have made something, «collect» on the left lights up. how many of each kind: one, plus one more every three island levels. no producer may be higher than the town hall.

a.s: Far from home, load men from your island's dwellings into boats: they catch you up anywhere at sea.
a.k: island boats шлюпы с острова boats reinforcements hire away шлюпы подкрепление найм далеко доставка far from home, load men from your island's dwellings into boats: they catch you up anywhere at sea. at sea, far from the island, open «⋯» → «boats» (or the island's town → «send the boats», or the crew window). the hire window opens in its boats mode. choose a kind, set the number and press «into the boats»: the fill bar at the top shows how full they are. press «send the boats». island prices plus a small delivery fee: the farther you are and the lower the town hall, the dearer. under way, the «boats coming» pill shows the time and the distance, and a dashed line runs on the dial. they come alongside and the men step aboard. the town hall decides everything: 10 to 14 times your speed, 1 to 3 stacks a trip, a quarter to all of your hammocks, and a break of 10 minutes down to 3.

a.s: Every cost chip tells where to get what is missing and can sail you to the nearest seller.
a.k: «where to get it» «где взять» where source tooltip resource где взять подсказка ресурс не хватает every cost chip tells where to get what is missing and can sail you to the nearest seller. short of something? tap its chip in the price (red means not enough): a «where to get it» card opens. it lists the sources: which ports sell it, the island's market (it sells straight to the yard), the barge, the producers. «sail to the nearest seller» lays the course; «more» opens the good's full card.

a.s: Free 15-minute speed-ups come every day; the rest is finished for doubloons.
a.k: rushing a build ускорить стройку rush speed up finish doubloons tokens ускорить ускорение завершить дублоны жетоны free 15-minute speed-ups come every day; the rest is finished for doubloons. a building under way shows its timer at the bottom with «speed up»: it spends your free tokens first (15 minutes each), then the shop's minutes. tokens: +2 for the daily login and +1 for each daily order, at most 20. speed-ups are never paid in silver. «finish for ◉n» ends it at once for doubloons: 0.6 a minute, from 290 to 9 900 — so 290 covers up to about 8 hours. packs of speed-ups and extra brigades are in the shop: «island» → «building».

a.s: In port: «Army» → «Recruit an army». Pick a kind, set the number, «Hire».
a.k: hiring an army как нанять армию hire recruit army dwellings tavern найм нанять армия жилища таверна юнги морпехи in port: «army» → «recruit an army». pick a kind, set the number, «hire». in any port open the «army» tab and press «recruit an army». the card above it is the surgeon. the «recruit» window lists every dwelling you can hire from: its name, how many wait and how many grow a week. each kind is a card with its price. tap a card: its stats appear on the right. move the slider or press «max», check the price and press «hire». the top row tells the limits: «hammocks» (men aboard), «stacks» (slots for squads), «picked» (tier 4 and up) and «might». plain deckhands are also hired in the «tavern»: the slider and «hire n». officers are there too.

a.s: Every dwelling of tier 2–7 on your island opens that tier for hire in every port.
a.k: island troops in any port бойцы острова в любом порту island dwellings your island deckhands ashore остров ваш остров жилища юнги на берег наценка every dwelling of tier 2–7 on your island opens that tier for hire in every port. dwellings of your island are marked «your island» in the hire window — in every port, on rafts and at floating waystations. their men are your island's pool. away from the island they cost a quarter more (marines: 75 instead of 60). deckhands always come from the tavern. on the island itself the price is the plain one, but the ship must lie off it. hammocks full of deckhands? hire a higher tier anyway: the line «deckhands go ashore: n» shows how many make room. some kinds need more: gunners from ship level ⚓2, boarders from ⚓4, guards from ⚓6. the drowned serve only captains of the choir and cursed ships.

a.s: In «The Company» (key O) or «Recruit»: tap a stack, then «Split» or «Dismiss»; drop it on its kind to merge.
a.k: stacks: split, merge, dismiss отряды: разделить, объединить, уволить stacks split merge dismiss slots crew отряды разделить объединить уволить команда ячейки in «the company» (key o) or «recruit»: tap a stack, then «split» or «dismiss»; drop it on its kind to merge. open «the company» (key o, or «⋯» → «army» at sea). the «army» card shows your stacks: tier, might and the number of men. tap a stack: «split», «dismiss» and «cancel» appear. the hint says it: drag it onto a stack of the same kind to merge, onto an empty slot to split. «split»: move the slider — «stays: a · new stack: b» — and confirm. at least one man moves and one stays, and a free slot is needed. two stacks of one kind fight as two squads in the boarding — handy to shield the shooters. stack slots grow with the hull: a sloop 4, a brig 6, a galleon and up 7. «dismiss» asks once more: the men leave the ship for good. one stack always stays aboard; none of this works in a boarding or with a party ashore.

a.s: The ship's level caps how strong an army it carries; deckhands are never capped.
a.k: «might x/y»: the ship's limit «сила x/y»: предел корабля might power cap limit picked сила предел отборные уровень корабля the ship's level caps how strong an army it carries; deckhands are never capped. «might x/y» in the hire window: x is your army now, y the most your ship takes. might is the army's boarding strength counted in deckhands. «picked» is a second limit: tier 4 and up may fill only part of the hammocks (from 15 % at ⚓1 to 45 %). y grows with the ship's level, its hammocks and its slots: a new hull or a refit raises it. when the army is as strong as the ship allows, the game says so and the hire stops; deckhands and titans are never capped.

a.s: Seven tiers, each with an upgraded kind; an upgraded dwelling retrains men for the price difference.
a.k: tiers and upgrades ранги и улучшение tier upgrade rank units ранг улучшение улучшить бойцы морская гвардия меткие стрелки seven tiers, each with an upgraded kind; an upgraded dwelling retrains men for the price difference. every dwelling has two cards: the plain kind and the upgraded one (gunners → bombardiers). the roman numeral on a stack is its tier; a gold chevron marks the upgraded kind. «unit upgrades» at the bottom of the hire window: «upgrade n» retrains a stack for the price difference — only where the dwelling is upgraded, and within the might limit. on your island a dwelling trains the upgraded kind from level 3. some men want goods besides silver: musketeers powder, gunners powder and iron, boarders rum, guards pearls.

a.s: A stack marked «gift» fights like any other, but its losses are never refilled.
a.k: gift stacks подарочные отряды gift present letter no refill подарок подарочный письмо не восполняются мушкетеры a stack marked «gift» fights like any other, but its losses are never refilled. gift stacks come in letters: «journal» → «letters», the attachment with the «gift» tag, «receive». no room aboard? dismiss someone in «the company»: the letter waits. the stack wears a red «gift» ribbon. it fights, trains and splits like any other. but nothing refills its losses: no hire, no first aid, no resurrection, no merging with hired men of the same kind. keep it out of the hardest blows.

a.s: Men fallen in the last 24 hours come back for silver at the surgeon in any port.
a.k: the surgeon and resurrection лекарь и воскрешение surgeon healer resurrect fallen лекарь воскресить павшие потери лечение men fallen in the last 24 hours come back for silver at the surgeon in any port. after a won boarding a third of the fallen stand up by themselves (more with first aid and artifacts, up to two thirds). the rest wait for the surgeon. port → «army» → «surgeon» → «raise the fallen». it works at a floating waystation too; at sea within 2 km of either it costs a quarter more. the list shows who fell and the price; «raise all» brings everyone back. the fallen wait 24 hours (and 20 battles). shop creatures come back only for doubloons, at half price.

a.s: 3 berths are free besides the ship you sail; each more costs 300 doubloons, up to 10. Swapping takes 2 minutes.
a.k: berths: keeping several ships причал: несколько кораблей berths ships swap keep buy причал пересесть корабли стоянка оставить старый 3 berths are free besides the ship you sail; each more costs 300 doubloons, up to 10. swapping takes 2 minutes. port → «berths»: «berths n/3», the ship under you and the ships you keep. each keeps its upgrades, guns, gear and level. buying a new hull at the shipyard asks: «trade in (hand the old over)» or «buy and keep the old one at the berth». to change ships press «board her» on a kept ship — in any port with a shipyard. your army and hold move with you (if the hold fits). more room: «+1 berth · 300» doubloons each, up to ten in all. the ship sails to you from her last mooring: «coming to you 1:58». stay in port — leaving cancels the call.

a.s: Convoy ships are hired at the harbour master once you command; merchants at sea can be hired as guards for a while.
a.k: convoy and hired guards конвой и наемная охрана escort convoy guards fleet конвой сопровождение охрана нанять в охрану командование convoy ships are hired at the harbour master once you command; merchants at sea can be hired as guards for a while. port → «harbour» → «convoy (n/m)»: a cutter, a brig or a brigantine sail with you in formation and fight at your side. upkeep is paid by the hour at sea. convoy captains obey only a commander: ten points in the «command» tree open the first berth, the escort captain talent and the admiral's pennant one more each (up to 3). in port the shipyard patches the convoy with your ship; at sea their carpenters mend them slowly out of battle. one that falls behind speeds up and catches the formation. a merchant of your level can also be hailed — «hire as guard» for 10–20 minutes.

a.s: A map draws a search circle on the chart; inside it «Warm → Warmer → Hot!» leads you to a scroll on the water — dig there.
a.k: treasure maps карты сокровищ treasure map dig circle scroll warm клад карта сокровищ копать круг свиток тепло горячо кладоискатель a map draws a search circle on the chart; inside it «warm → warmer → hot!» leads you to a scroll on the water — dig there. open the chart and turn on the «treasure» layer: each map you hold shows its search circle — 900, 1 400 or 2 000 m by its tier — with «treasure: <place>». the exact spot is never drawn. «sail to the treasure» takes the ship to the circle. maps come from tavern rumours, the cartographer, wrecks and finds; the chest holds 6. inside the circle the hint guides you: «warm» far off, «warmer» within 1.3 km, «hot!» within 700 m. look for the scroll on the water. the scroll shows within 400 m: «scroll in sight». sail up to it, or tap it and the ship comes by itself. over the spot press «dig» (key l). the boats go ashore with spades: 60, 95 or 130 s by the tier. digging is heard 2 km off, and rich maps may raise guardians. the «treasure hunter» talent (exploration tree) shrinks the circle by 20 % a rank and digs 15 % faster a rank.

a.s: Over a sunken wreck press «Divers»: in 25 s they bring up its cargo; the depth decides if they reach it.
a.k: wrecks and divers затонувшие корабли и водолазы wreck dive divers depth pearl diver затонувший остов ныряльщики водолазы глубина ловец жемчуга over a sunken wreck press «divers»: in 25 s they bring up its cargo; the depth decides if they reach it. stand over the wreck (within 30 m): the action bar shows «divers» with its name. press it or key l. wrecks for divers are on the chart's «goals» layer with their depth, «<name> · n m». each can be dived again 2 hours later. the countdown «divers on the bottom»: going down, searching, coming up. the ship lies at anchor meanwhile. without a talent divers reach only 8 m. «pearl diver» (exploration) takes them to 20 m at rank 1 and 40 m at rank 2 — most wrecks lie deep.

a.s: At a ruin, a cache or a mine, «Land» sends a party ashore; it comes back with the haul.
a.k: landing parties высадка на остров landing party ruins cache ashore высадка десант руины тайник берег at a ruin, a cache or a mine, «land» sends a party ashore; it comes back with the haul. near a feature of an island the action bar offers «land» (key l). the party is 30 % of the crew, 3 to 12 men; the boats reach 30 m from the shore — if a beach is close, the helmsman sails in first. the countdown «landing party ashore»: the boats on the water, on the shore, rowing back. a cache takes 20 s, ruins 40, a lookout 15. back aboard: «the party is back» with the haul. ruins sometimes hide a find with its own riddle. a place restocks 2 hours later.

a.t: Work at a spot: the countdown
a.s: Divers, a landing, a dig: a countdown at the top, the ship at anchor; «Call off» brings the men back.
a.k: work at a spot: the countdown дела на месте: отсчет countdown anchor call off timer dig dive отсчет якорь прервать таймер дрейф divers, a landing, a dig: a countdown at the top, the ship at anchor; «call off» brings the men back. while your men work, a pill sits at the top: what they do, the phase («boats on the water», «digging»…) and the time left. «call off» recalls them. before half the time — nothing found; after half — half the haul. setting sail or turning the wheel calls them off too. the ship glides to a stop over 2–3 seconds and lies at anchor: wind and current do not carry her off. the same timer sits by the portrait. under fire before half time, up to 30 % of the party may be lost.

a.s: Beat a mine's guards, land and raise your flag: it pays every sea day. Up to 7 mines.
a.k: mines and your flag шахты и ваш флаг mine flag yield silver mine guards шахта рудник флаг добыча стража поднять флаг beat a mine's guards, land and raise your flag: it pays every sea day. up to 7 mines. at a mine the prompt says what it needs: «guards stand before the mine: beat them first». a mine held by raiders wants a party at least as big as their garrison (4, 8 or 14 men). guards beaten: press «land» (key l) by the mine. «raising the flag»: 20 seconds. a fresh flag is safe for 10 minutes. your flag flies: the yield goes to your island every sea day (48 minutes) — a silver mine 250 a day, timber 14, iron 7, tar 10, powder 5, pearls 1, rum 8; ×0.75 in safe waters, ×1.5 in lawless ones. without an island it piles up at the mine, up to a week. mines are on the chart's «all» layer: «your mine», «· raiders», «· nobody's». you hold at most 7; raiders may come for a mine once in a while.

a.s: A beaten lair comes back in 2–4 sea days; its full loot is yours once a week.
a.k: lairs and their return логова и когда они возвращаются lair creatures respawn loot pirate lair логово твари вернется добыча пиратское логово штурм a beaten lair comes back in 2–4 sea days; its full loot is yours once a week. at a creatures' lair the action bar offers «assault» (key l): a hex battle on the shore against its beasts. «look…» tells what lives there. on the «lairs» layer a beaten lair is grey with «comes back in …»: a shore lair after 1 h 36 min, a grotto after 2 h 24 min, a guardian after 3 h 12 min. its full loot is each captain's once a sea week. a pirate battery is rebuilt after 6 hours. «look…» shows its card at the top: how many, what kind and level, «land and fight» or «let them be». named pirates come back 12–24 hours after they are sunk.

a.s: Driftwood, wreck fields, fairway buoys, lanterns, floating bones, ice floes: stop by one and press its button.
a.k: sea marks морские знаки sea mark buoy wreckage driftwood lantern знак бакен поле обломков плавник фонарь льдина driftwood, wreck fields, fairway buoys, lanterns, floating bones, ice floes: stop by one and press its button. within 30 m of a mark its button appears: «pick up», «search», «read», «trim the lantern», «fish out the bones», «cut ice». «boats at the mark»: 2 to 4 seconds. a wreck field may hold a treasure map (4 %). a fairway buoy «read» charts an island within 4 km. wrecks, driftwood and bones are yours again after 48 hours, the rest after 24.

a.s: Climb a lookout to chart 5 km of sea; a lit lighthouse shows the shoals at night.
a.k: lookouts and lighthouses смотровые и маяки lookout lighthouse keeper night shoals смотровая маяк смотритель ночь мели climb a lookout to chart 5 km of sea; a lit lighthouse shows the shoals at night. a lookout on a cape: «land» by it (key l). the chart marks it ▲ — red until climbed, grey after. «climbing the lookout»: 15 seconds. islands, reefs and wrecks within 5 km go on the chart and the fog lifts there (60 % of it if called off after half). again after 2 hours. the chart's key explains the rest: a lit lighthouse shows shoals and reefs in its light, 3.5 km, by night. crown lights always burn; in contested waters a keeper lights his for 30 minutes — pay him («keeper») at dusk or by night.

a.t: The chart of the known sea
a.s: Key M. Layers pick what is drawn; «Key» explains every mark; buttons find you, your island and a foe.
a.k: the chart of the known sea карта известного моря chart map layers legend key where am i карта слои условные знаки где я найти врага к острову key m. layers pick what is drawn; «key» explains every mark; buttons find you, your island and a foe. layers: «ports», «goals», «lairs», «treasure», «all» and «shipyards» (with the yard's rank and ship levels, e.g. «shipyard 2 · ⚓1–6»). «key» opens the legend: every circle, colour and sign of the chart in words. «where am i» centres on your ship, «to the island» lays the course home, «find a foe» lists pirates, beasts and lairs nearby by level and distance — a tap sets the course. «where is my level»: the nearest archipelago of your ship's level and «show on the chart». below — the day's orders and the common goal.

a.s: «Journal» → «Chronicle»: the last 300 events with filters.
a.k: «chronicle»: everything that happened «хроника»: все, что случилось chronicle log journal history хроника журнал история добыча бои «journal» → «chronicle»: the last 300 events with filters. «journal» → «chronicle» records everything: cargo raised, finds of divers and landings, treasures, bottles, boardings with their loot, who you sank and who sank you, rewards, deals, buildings. filters: «all», «loot», «battles», «quests», «island». the last 300 entries, by days. simple reports — weekly supplies, the island's news — go here, not to the mail: letters come only with an attachment or something to do.

a.s: The sea is dark until you see it; once seen, it stays on your chart.
a.k: the fog of war туман войны fog unknown sight scouts туман неизвестно обзор разведчики the sea is dark until you see it; once seen, it stays on your chart. a new captain's chart is mostly fog: only the start port (6 km around) and what she has sailed past. unknown ports show as dim signs without a name. your ship sees 2.4 km around (less in rain and fog, at least 1.5 km); every port visited opens 3.5 km. lookouts and buoys chart more. your island sees 4 km plus 1 km per town hall level; a lighthouse and a signal tower add 1.5 km each, a chart house 2 km. up to 3 scouts sail out to 30 km.

a.s: Every 100 km sailed is a page of the log: «Cartographer» pays experience, «Pathfinder» morale and speed.
a.k: the navigator's distance perks таланты штурмана за пройденный путь navigator cartographer pathfinder star fix distance штурман картограф первопроходец обсервация путь вахтенный журнал every 100 km sailed is a page of the log: «cartographer» pays experience, «pathfinder» morale and speed. a leg counts after 5 km in a straight line from the last one; circling in place counts nothing, and at most 120 km an hour. «cartographer» pays experience for each 100 km page, up to 12 pages a day. «pathfinder»: each page gives +5 morale and +2 % speed a rank until the next page (an hour at most); a new island +10 morale. the navigator's «star fix» (key c): islands, wrecks and sea marks within 7 km go on the chart, and +8 % speed for 3 minutes plus a minute per 10 km since the last fix (10 at most).

a.s: Seven hub harbours are linked by the «Passage»: 800 to 15 000 silver by distance, a trip at ten times the speed, untouchable, docking on arrival.
a.k: the passage between hubs переход между гаванями ferry passage hub travel переход гавань узел путешествие seven hub harbours are linked by the «passage»: 800 to 15 000 silver by distance, a trip at ten times the speed, untouchable, docking on arrival. in a hub harbour the port window has the «passage» chip first in its second row (the same list sits at the top of «harbour»). the hubs: port gravesend, hollowmere, tidewrack, fogmouth, widow's wick, frostgate and sealhold. each row is a hub with its price: 800 silver for the nearest pair, up to 15 000 for the farthest. a hub you have not discovered yet is greyed out: «discover this port first». press the price button and you are off. the ship sails there by herself at ten times the speed; no one can touch her and she cannot act. on the way a pill on top shows where you are going and how long is left. on arrival you dock in the hub at once.

a.s: Once in 30 minutes. Under the pirate flag ×2, towards a quest's goal ×0.25. Not with skulls, not in a fight, and not with trade goods over 60 % of the hold.
a.k: the passage's rules правила перехода ferry passage cooldown price pirate quest hold переход перезарядка цена пират задание трюм once in 30 minutes. under the pirate flag ×2, towards a quest's goal ×0.25. not with skulls, not in a fight, and not with trade goods over 60 % of the hold. under the pirate flag every passage costs twice as much. with a skull it is refused altogether: «wash first». going to the hub nearest an active quest's goal costs a quarter, with the tag «quest discount». if trade goods take more than 60 % of the hold, the passage refuses: sell or store some first. ship's stores do not count. it is also refused in a fight, in a mutiny and during a refit. after a passage the next one waits 30 minutes of real time; the status line under the list and the «passage cooldown» icon show how long.

a.s: Within 1 km of every hub no captain can attack another. After a passage the protection follows you for 3 more minutes.
a.k: the quiet harbour тихая гавань haven safe protection hub тихая гавань защита безопасность узел within 1 km of every hub no captain can attack another. after a passage the protection follows you for 3 more minutes. on the chart the hubs carry a brass ⇄ badge and a green dashed ring: the «quiet harbour», 1000 m round the port. inside it captains cannot fight each other. arrived by passage? once you leave the ring you keep «harbour's protection» for 180 s more. it guards against captains only: the sea's pirates and beasts attack as usual.

a.s: «To my island» in the «⋯» tray or at the bottom of the chart sets the course home; with no island yet, to the nearest free one.
a.k: «to my island» «к острову» island home course остров домой курс «to my island» in the «⋯» tray or at the bottom of the chart sets the course home; with no island yet, to the nearest free one. open the «⋯» tray by the portrait: «to my island» is there. a tap sets the course and the helmsman takes her; the pill on top shows the way. no island yet? the course goes to the nearest free one: «no island yet: course to the nearest free one». the same button stands at the bottom of the chart, beside «where am i» and «find foe».

a.s: A list of the pirates, beasts, monsters and lairs you can see or have charted within 30 km, filtered by kind and level. Tap a row for the course.
a.k: «find foe» «найти врага» foe hunt pirates beasts lairs враг охота пираты звери логова a list of the pirates, beasts, monsters and lairs you can see or have charted within 30 km, filtered by kind and level. tap a row for the course. «find foe» is in the «⋯» tray by the portrait (and at the bottom of the chart). the panel lists what is in sight or already charted — never anything under the fog. the chips «all», «pirates», «beasts», «monsters», «lairs» filter by kind. the level chips: «⚓ yours ±2» for a fair fight, «⚓ ±5», «any ⚓». the search reaches 30 km. tap a row and the course is set: the helmsman takes you to the foe. turn the wheel to take over.

a.s: Up to level 60. Quests are the steadiest source of experience; each level gives a talent point.
a.k: levels and experience уровни и опыт level experience xp rested уровень опыт отдых очки таланта up to level 60. quests are the steadiest source of experience; each level gives a talent point. the number on your portrait is your captain's level, up to 60. the captain window shows the bar to the next level. experience: a quest pays like ten ships of your level, a boarding two sinkings, the daily chest fourteen; grey targets give nothing, stronger ones up to half again more. every level after the first is one talent point («free: n points»). resting in port fills a pool — 1/20 of a level per 8 hours, up to 1.5 levels — and battle experience counts double until it is spent.

a.s: Ten trees around the wind rose; tiers open at 0/5/10/15/20 points in a tree.
a.k: talents: the wind rose таланты: роза ветров talents tree points respec таланты ветвь очки переучивание роза ветров ten trees around the wind rose; tiers open at 0/5/10/15/20 points in a tree. open «talents» (key t, or the captain window → «talents»). ten trees around the wind rose: navigation, exploration, the abyss, survival, shipwright, command, gunnery, boarding, smuggling, trade. tap a tree: its tiers open at 0, 5, 10, 15 and 20 points spent in it; keystones want 25 points and level 25. tap a talent to learn a rank. respec works only in port, with a 10-minute break between changes; two sets («1» and «2») keep two builds.

a.s: HoMM-style: primary skills grow every level, secondary skills are picked one of two; sea abilities rank up with the level.
a.k: skills of the captain навыки и умения капитана skills primary secondary abilities навыки первичные вторичные умения атака защита homm-style: primary skills grow every level, secondary skills are picked one of two; sea abilities rank up with the level. captain → «hero»: the primary skills — attack, defence, order power, will. one grows each level. «new level: choose a skill»: one of two secondary skills, «take». there are 12 of them and 8 slots; each is kin to a talent tree. «abilities»: your sea abilities z, x, c and the passive rank up at levels 1, 12, 24, 36, 48, the ultimate v at 6, 20, 35, 50. facets open at ranks 3 and 5.

a.s: 36 chapters, 720 quests: one at a time, the next comes by itself when your level allows.
a.k: the campaign кампания campaign story chapter кампания сюжет глава 36 chapters, 720 quests: one at a time, the next comes by itself when your level allows. «journal» → «quests»: the campaign is on top, under «story». tap it for the giver, the steps and the pay. «campaign» opens the chapter book: where you are and what is ahead, each chapter with its levels. some steps are forks where you choose a way. the next quest comes by itself once your level allows («the next from level n»). «goals and news» at sea shows the current one. playing only the campaign brings you to level 60 by its end; past chapter 31 the way through the maelstrom wall opens.

a.s: Take quests from a port's board; the journal groups them by the place to hand them in, nearest first.
a.k: quests, grouped by the giver задания по местам выдачи quests journal giver distance sail there задания журнал сдавать здесь плыть туда доска take quests from a port's board; the journal groups them by the place to hand them in, nearest first. port → «quests»: the board, best for you first, with chips «all», «side», «jobs», «contracts», «urgent», «for the day», «guild», «taken». «take» opens the giver's words, the steps and the pay. in the journal quests are grouped: «story», then each port and island with «hand in here · n km to it», nearest first, then «contracts» and «dailies». every quest has its distance and a «sail there» button: the helmsman lays the course.

a.s: Contracts pay silver and experience; three daily orders and their chest reset at midnight UTC.
a.k: contracts and daily orders контракты и поручения дня contracts dailies orders chest streak контракты ежедневные поручения дня сундук серия contracts pay silver and experience; three daily orders and their chest reset at midnight utc. «contracts» on the board: deliveries, couriers, bounties (only in lawful ports). each port posts 4, renewed every 15 minutes; you may hold up to 60. each also gives 45 season experience. «for the day»: three daily orders by your level. all three open a chest; its silver grows 10 % a day for a streak, up to 5 days. the same orders are in the journal under «dailies», with the weekly contests and the common goal of the sea.

a.s: 100 tiers in two months; a free track and a premium one. Season experience comes from almost everything you do.
a.k: the season card сезонная карта season pass premium super pass tiers сезон пропуск премиум суперпропуск ступени испытания 100 tiers in two months; a free track and a premium one. season experience comes from almost everything you do. the «season» button opens the season card: your tier, the season experience bar and two tracks of rewards, «free» and «premium». «claim all» takes what you have earned. the premium track opens with the «premium pass»; the «super pass» is the premium track plus 20 tiers at once and the «abyss» frame. tier 100 gives a ⚓7 «thunderer». «challenges»: 3 daily (150 each) and 4 weekly (900 each). season experience also comes from quests, contracts, lairs, bosses, pvp, treasures and the island, each with a daily limit. «pass ★» compares the passes and their prices. a season lasts two calendar months: season 1, «storm over gravewater», runs to 31 december; the card shows how long is left.

a.s: «Might» is 35 % army, 25 % ship, 20 % island and 20 % gear; the site's rating has boards for each.
a.k: the rating: «level» and «might» рейтинг: «уровень» и «мощь» rating might power leaderboard рейтинг мощь таблица место «might» is 35 % army, 25 % ship, 20 % island and 20 % gear; the site's rating has boards for each. captain → «might»: your might and your place among all captains. its four parts, each with your place: the army 35 %, the ship 25 %, the island 20 %, the gear 20 %. each is out of about 10 000 for a captain with everything upgraded. «the mightiest captains» below. the rating on the site has boards for level, might, army, ship, island, gear, glory, pvp and more — the top 100, refreshed every minute; a tap on a captain opens his profile.

a.s: Points for captains sunk and boarded; the month's top ten get titles, doubloons and silver.
a.k: the pvp board таблица пвп pvp points season rewards пвп очки сезон награды гроза морей points for captains sunk and boarded; the month's top ten get titles, doubloons and silver. captain → «pvp»: the month's season, your points, captains beaten, deaths, duels and streaks. rewards at the month's end: titles «storm of the seas», «sea hawk», «boarder» for the top three, silver and doubloons to the tenth place, a share of silver for everyone with 50+ points. a sinking gives 10 points, a boarding 14, a duel 5; up to ×2.5 against stronger captains, ×1.5 in a guild war. the same captain again within a day gives half, then a quarter, then nothing. the board resets on the 1st.

a.s: «Settings» → «Promo code» → «Enter»: type the code and press «Activate».
a.k: promo codes промокоды promo code gift settings промокод код подарок настройки «settings» → «promo code» → «enter»: type the code and press «activate». open «settings» (the menu «⋯» or the captain's menu) and press «enter» by «promo code». type the code into the field and press «activate». letters may be in any case. the answer is right under it: what you got, or why the code did not fit (spent, expired, not for your level). each code works once a captain; codes for newcomers work up to level 15.

a.s: A 28-day track, one claim a day; one missed day is forgiven.
a.k: the daily gift награда за вход daily gift login streak награда за вход ежедневный подарок подарок дни подряд a 28-day track, one claim a day; one missed day is forgiven. the gift opens by itself when you are free (or from «⋯»): four weeks of seven days. press «claim» — or «later». the 7th day of each week gives doubloons (25 in the 4th week); silver grows by a quarter every week. «days in a row»: one missed day is forgiven, two — and the count starts over. one claim per day (utc).

a.s: Doubloons buy speed-ups, supplies, scrolls, ship looks and island help; «Top up» buys doubloons.
a.k: the doubloon shop лавка за дублоны shop doubloons premium offers лавка дублоны акции набор новичка пополнить doubloons buy speed-ups, supplies, scrolls, ship looks and island help; «top up» buys doubloons. the shop has four tabs: «sea», «boarding», «island», «cosmetics»; «deals» are on top. deals: the «newcomer's kit» once an account, the «captain's subscription» (30 days of 100 doubloons a day), the «weekly chest», a gift for each 10th level. the first top-up is doubled (up to 2 600). «boarding»: autobattle scrolls, luck talismans, the elixir of experience and more. «sea» has ammunition, repair kits, crews, fair winds, pardons, treasure maps.

a.t: Where do I buy a bigger ship?
a.s: Bigger hulls are sold only at higher-rank shipyards: the chart's «Shipyards» layer shows each yard's rank and ship levels.
a.k: where do i buy a bigger ship? где купить корабль побольше? ship bigger shipyard yard rank корабль больше верфь ранг верфи где купить bigger hulls are sold only at higher-rank shipyards: the chart's «shipyards» layer shows each yard's rank and ship levels. chart → «shipyards»: «shipyard 2 · ⚓1–6» — the yard's rank and the ship levels it sells. undiscovered yards of rank 2+ show dimly, without a name: sail and find them. in such a port: «shipyard» → «all ships». port gravesend has a rank-4 yard right by the start. buying asks: trade the old one in, or keep it at the berth. every hull's full card — hold, crew, slots, guns, where it is sold — is in the ship tree and on the site's «fleet» page.

a.t: How do I bring silver and goods to my island?
a.s: Island → «Bring in»: silver into the treasury from anywhere, goods unloaded off the island, or a barge for silver.
a.k: how do i bring silver and goods to my island? как завезти серебро и товары на остров? island silver goods treasury barge остров серебро ресурсы казна барка завезти island → «bring in»: silver into the treasury from anywhere, goods unloaded off the island, or a barge for silver. the island window → «bring in» (or tap the treasury coin at the top). «put in the treasury» or «all the silver» — at sea or in port. the treasury pays for building, the market and the barge first. goods: lie off your island and press «unload all» — they go from the hold to the yard. no ship nearby? «order a barge» brings timber, coal and iron, and the island's market sells resources straight to the yard.

a.t: How do I take a mine?
a.s: Beat its guards, land by it and raise your flag in 20 seconds. Up to 7 mines.
a.k: how do i take a mine? как взять шахту? mine flag guards шахта флаг стража добыча beat its guards, land by it and raise your flag in 20 seconds. up to 7 mines. at a nobody's mine the prompt says: «guards stand before the mine: beat them first». then «land» by the mine: the party raises your flag in 20 seconds. the yield goes to your island every sea day, or piles up at the mine for up to a week. at most 7 mines at once.

a.t: Where do I temper gear and forge artifacts?
a.s: Gear: the island's «Forge» (Town Hall 3+) or a port with a shipyard of rank 2+. Artifacts: the «Workshop» and the «Anvil» (a Market is needed).
