a.k: where do i temper gear and forge artifacts? где закаляют снаряжение и куют артефакты? gear temper forge artifact anvil шмот снаряжение закалка кузница артефакт наковальня gear: the island's «forge» (town hall 3+) or a port with a shipyard of rank 2+. artifacts: the «workshop» and the «anvil» (a market is needed). build the «forge» on a plot of your island (from town hall 3): lying off the island you temper, reforge and mend gear. artifacts are made in the island town's «workshop» — a market of level 1 or higher is needed, and the ship off the island. the «anvil» next to it reforges an artifact you carry: its primaries or one forged line.

a.t: How many ships can I keep?
a.s: Three berths free plus the ship under you — four in all; more for 300 doubloons each, up to ten.
a.k: how many ships can i keep? сколько кораблей можно держать? berths ships how many причал корабли сколько места three berths free plus the ship under you — four in all; more for 300 doubloons each, up to ten. port → «berths»: «berths n/3» — three places are free, and the ship you sail is not counted. «+1 berth · 300»: each more costs 300 doubloons, up to ten. changing ships takes 2 minutes: the ship sails to you from her last mooring. a ship kept at your island is taken out at the island.

a.t: When does a lair come back?
a.s: A shore lair in 1 h 36 min, a grotto in 2 h 24 min, a guardian in 3 h 12 min; full loot once a sea week.
a.k: when does a lair come back? когда возвращается логово? lair respawn when логово вернется когда добыча a shore lair in 1 h 36 min, a grotto in 2 h 24 min, a guardian in 3 h 12 min; full loot once a sea week. chart → «lairs»: a beaten lair is grey with «comes back in …». shore lairs return after 2 sea days (1 h 36 min), grottoes after 3 (2 h 24 min), guardians after 4 (3 h 12 min). the full loot is each captain's once a sea week (5 h 36 min). «look…» by the lair tells who lives there and how strong.

a.s: Your island's marines are hired only once the Marine Barracks stand; big ports have marines of their own.
a.k: why can't i hire marines? почему не нанимаются морпехи? marines barracks hire морпехи казарма нанять не нанимаются your island's marines are hired only once the marine barracks stand; big ports have marines of their own. while the barracks are going up, the card shows how long is left: nothing is hired until it stands. big ports (and crown and league harbours) have their own marine barracks: «army» lists the dwellings of this port. marines are tier 2, open from ship level ⚓1. if the hire stops, look at «hammocks», «stacks» and «might» at the top.

a.t: How does the «Passage» between ports work?
a.s: Seven hub ports; open the «Passage» tab, pick an opened hub, pay. 800 to 15 000 silver, 30 minutes' cooldown.
a.k: how does the «passage» between ports work? как работает «переход» между портами? ferry passage hub travel переход узел порт-узел тихая гавань seven hub ports; open the «passage» tab, pick an opened hub, pay. 800 to 15 000 silver, 30 minutes' cooldown. in a hub port (⇄ on the chart) open «passage»: the other hubs with their price. unopened ones are grey, «open this port first». the price grows with the distance (800 to the next hub, 15 000 across the sea), double under the pirate flag, a quarter for your quest's hub. not with skulls, in a mutiny or with trade cargo over 60 % of the hold. within 1 km of every hub lies the «quiet harbour»: captains do not attack each other there, and a newcomer by passage is under its ward for 3 minutes more.

a.t: What does my crew do while I am away?
a.s: At sea they eat provisions, in port they drink silver — a quarter of the usual, for at most a day.
a.k: what does my crew do while i am away? что делает команда, пока меня нет? away offline upkeep provisions morale офлайн без меня провизия дух жалованье at sea they eat provisions, in port they drink silver — a quarter of the usual, for at most a day. left at sea, the crew eats a quarter of its rations; take provisions before you log off («supplies» in the market). in port they spend a quarter of their wages. at most 24 hours are counted, nothing below a quarter of an hour, and it never goes below zero. short of it, morale falls (up to −30) and up to 15 % may desert. below level 6 the bill is halved and nobody deserts. the account waits for you: «settlement for your absence».

a.t: Can I just close the tab at sea?
a.s: No escape that way: at sea the ship stays 2 minutes and can be attacked. Use «Exit»: 30 seconds.
a.k: can i just close the tab at sea? можно ли просто закрыть вкладку в море? exit logout close escape выход закрыть сбежать оффлайн no escape that way: at sea the ship stays 2 minutes and can be attacked. use «exit»: 30 seconds. «⋯» → «exit» (⏻). at sea: «exit in 0:30». any order of yours or a shot at you cancels it. lost the connection or closed the game at sea? the ship stays 2 minutes on her last order — she can be attacked, boarded and sunk. back within those 2 minutes, you are at the wheel again. in port the exit is instant.

a.s: «Journal» → «Letters», in any port: «Receive». No room aboard — dismiss someone, the letter waits.
a.k: where is my gift letter? где письмо с подарком? gift letter mail musketeers подарок письмо почта мушкетеры получить «journal» → «letters», in any port: «receive». no room aboard — dismiss someone, the letter waits. open «journal» → «letters»: the letter with its attachment. press «receive» in any port: the silver goes to your purse and the stack aboard. no free hammocks or slots? dismiss someone in «the company» («dismiss») — the letter waits until there is room.

a.t: Why does the surgeon offer to raise deckhands?
a.s: The surgeon raises exactly who fell in the last 24 hours — by kind, at the price of their kind.
a.k: why does the surgeon offer to raise deckhands? почему лекарь предлагает воскресить юнг? surgeon resurrect deckhands fallen лекарь воскресить юнги павшие the surgeon raises exactly who fell in the last 24 hours — by kind, at the price of their kind. port → «army» → «surgeon»: «fallen: n» counts everyone lost in the last day. the list is by kind: if deckhands fell, it offers deckhands — those men, not «any 12 sailors». their price is a share of their kind's cost. the fallen wait a day and up to 20 battles. missing men of any kind are simply hired — in the tavern or the hire window.
